subject.title: [Bug]: Assistant text preceding a tool call in the same turn is silently dropped on Signal channel (Anthropic/Sonnet, non-streaming)

question: Should suppressed pre-tool commentary be represented to later model turns as undelivered internal context, or should OpenClaw instead deliver selected pre-tool text or require explicit message-tool sends for user-visible confirmations?
rationale: The current source-backed bug is real, but the fix crosses a delivery-policy boundary because sending all pre-tool text risks channel leaks while hiding it without replay markers creates phantom shared history.

options.title: Accept Replay Markers
options.body: Use the linked PR direction so suppressed commentary remains private but later turns are told it was not shown to the user.

options.title: Deliver Selected Pre-Tool Text
options.body: Ask for a different implementation that can safely classify and flush only intentional user-facing pre-tool text without reviving commentary leaks.

options.title: Require Explicit Sends
options.body: Document bare pre-tool text as private and require message-tool or equivalent explicit sends for channel-visible confirmations.

recommendation.title: Accept Replay Markers
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR direction so suppressed commentary remains private but later turns are told it was not shown to the user.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-main routing signal for the sampled Anthropic commentary, subscriber suppression, payload, and replay-normalization surfaces.
